sources.check-features.py:
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();work=root/'.work/measure-20261120'
r=json.loads((work/'build-size.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
old=json.loads((root/'docs/measurements/2026-11-17-size-speed.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
checks={c['variant']:c['feature_checks'] for c in old['build_and_size']['configurations'] if c['target']=='x86_64-windows-gnu'}
alias={'no-graphics':'no-graphics-only','no-audio':'no-audio-only','no-graphics-float':'no-graphics-no-float'}
for row in r['configurations']:
 if row['variant'] not in alias or row['label'].endswith('-baseline'):continue
 binary=root/row['executable']
 for item in checks[alias[row['variant']]]:
  args=[str(binary),'-e',item['source']] if 'windows' in row['target'] else ['wsl.exe','--exec','/mnt/d/home/source/zig/forthz/'+row['executable'],'-e',item['source']]
  result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',timeout=30)
  passed=result.returncode==0 and result.stdout.strip()==item['expected'] and not result.stderr
  assert passed,(row['label'],result.stdout,result.stderr)
  row['feature_checks'].append({'source':item['source'],'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr,'exit_code':result.returncode,'expected':item['expected'],'passed':passed})
 (work/(row['label']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
(work/'build-size.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('Supplementary feature checks passed')

import subprocess,time,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();work=root/'.work/measure-20261120'
while not (work/'build-size.json').exists():time.sleep(1)
with (work/'feature-checks.log').open('w',encoding='utf-8') as log:subprocess.run(['python',str(work/'check-features.py')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
linux=['wsl.exe','--cd','/mnt/d/home/source/zig/forthz','--exec','python3','scripts/benchmark-runtime.py','--cpu','0','--sigma','current=./.work/measure-20261120/x86_64-linux-musl-full/bin/sigma','--sigma','before=./.work/measure-20261120/x86_64-linux-musl-full-baseline/bin/sigma','--gforth','gforth-1.0.2=/usr/local/bin/gforth-1.0.2-amd64','--gforth','gforth-fast-1.0.2=/usr/local/bin/gforth-fast-1.0.2-amd64','--iterations','100000000','--rounds','7','--output','.work/measure-20261120/benchmark-linux.json']
windows=['python','scripts/benchmark-runtime.py','--cpu','0','--sigma','current='+str(work/'x86_64-windows-gnu-full/bin/sigma.exe'),'--sigma','before='+str(work/'x86_64-windows-gnu-full-baseline/bin/sigma.exe'),'--iterations','100000000','--rounds','7','--output',str(work/'benchmark-windows.json')]
(work/'benchmark-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'linux':linux,'windows':windows},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for name,cmd in [('linux',linux),('windows',windows)]:
 print('Starting',name,flush=True)
 with (work/('benchmark-'+name+'-progress.log')).open('w',encoding='utf-8') as log:subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print('Completed',name,flush=True)
